title: Loading .env before require(./bot) made LOG_LEVEL from .env take effect on the live bot, an undeclared boot behaviour change; an invalid value would stop the boot
severity_rationale: S3, equal to the estimate: an undeclared boot behaviour change. No capital path.

evidence.note: the fix: .env is read into a private object, so process.env and boot order are unchanged

sibling_sites_checked: logger.ts reads LOG_LEVEL before config.ts runs dotenv; src/main.ts is the only code that runs before bot.ts loads.
